headline: Maysan Oil Company Raises Production at "Noor" Station to More Than 10,000 Barrels per Day
summary: Iraq's Maysan Oil Company said production at its Noor gas separation oil station has exceeded 10,000 barrels per day. The company said the station's capacity has reached that level.
why: Maysan Oil Company is an Iraqi state-owned producer, and Iraq is one of OPEC's largest crude exporters.
